A1.justification: Both complete 19-page PDFs describe PAT3D and contain readable text, equations, Table 1, Figures 1–12, and Appendices A–G. Textual and visual inspection supports a reliable comparison, including relocated content.

before.justification: v1 reports original quantitative scene-generation evaluations in Table 1, qualitative comparisons, simulation applications, and ablation results.

after.justification: v2 retains the original quantitative evaluations, generated-scene comparisons, simulation demonstrations, and ablations, including appendix examples.

M1.justification: The object-generation pipeline, scene-tree construction, layout initialization, semantic loss, and differentiable simulation procedure are unchanged in Section 3 and Appendices A–C.

E1.justification: Both evaluate the same 18 comparison prompts, retain 12 additional examples, and demonstrate the same scene-editing and robotic-manipulation scenarios. Appendix figure relocation introduces no new coverage.

E2.justification: GraphDreamer, Blender-MCP, and MIDI remain the evaluated baselines in Table 1 and the corresponding visual comparisons. Newly cited related works are not added as experimental comparators.

E3.justification: The five metrics, shared reference-image procedure for MIDI, 18-view rendering protocol, normalization and remeshing procedures, and simulation settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The Raw layout and Scene Init. ablations, initialization and optimization demonstrations in Figures 6–7, and failure cases in Figures 8–9 are retained. Shortening Table 1's caption does not remove the Scene Init. analysis.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. Statistical reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: All Table 1 scores match, including PAT3D's CLIP 31.79, VQA 0.68, displacement 0, penetration ratio 0, and physical score 88.5. The qualitative outputs, failure outcomes, timing measurements, and appendix examples also remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, optimization formulation, forward-simulation equations, implicit-differentiation derivation, and metric formulas are unchanged. Broken citations in Appendix B do not alter the retained mathematics.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same novelty, physical-validity, semantic-consistency, and downstream-application claims. No scientific contribution is added or redefined.

C2.justification: Interpretations of baseline behavior and ablation outcomes are retained. The limitations concerning hanging relations, larger scenes, crowded configurations, and local optimization remain substantively identical.

D1.justification: The introduction replaces the future-release promise with a GitHub address stating that code and data are available. Sections 4.2.1–4.2.2 add supplementary animation/video pointers. Implementation settings are unchanged; the abstract still promises release upon acceptance, and Appendix B.1 loses its identifiable further-details reference.

R1.justification: Section 2 adds Layout-your-3D and LiteReality with limited positioning updates. The bibliography removes Physics-Based Simulation, Li et al. (2023), and Lan et al. (2023; 2025), leaving '?' and '???' citation markers in Appendices B.1 and B.4. The central research positioning remains unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 adds Section 6 acknowledgments and makes localized edits to related work, availability statements, supplementary-material pointers, and captions. The main narrative and appendix organization otherwise remain stable.

P2.justification: The same figures and table are retained with spacing and sizing adjustments. Figure 11 moves from page 18 to page 17. Table 1's caption drops its Scene Init. explanation, and Figures 8–9 receive shorter captions; these are presentation changes to retained evidence.

improvement.justification: The concrete code/data access information provides a limited practical improvement over v1's deferred-release promise, and the related-work additions improve context. These gains are tempered by broken references in Appendices B.1/B.4, inconsistent release wording, and a less informative Table 1 caption. The method and empirical support are unchanged; the improvement concerns documentation and access instructions, not verified repository contents.
